scope: Diagnostics, failure modes, fail-closed behavior, deterministic classification, provenance and mutable-state integrity over the six route-native routes and the 20-case bounded G11 corpus.

requirements.limitation: None within the executed invalid-input classes; this is not a claim for unsupported future input schemas.
The five contract classes are covered; no universal conditioning threshold is introduced.
Full applies to the unsupported combinations exercised by the bounded corpus, without generalizing to unregistered combinations.
All nine contract failure classes are represented; route-specific exception types remain native.
The 20-case corpus is deterministic and exploitable, but the contract wording names all public failure classes and all structured nonlinear reasons; exhaustive public-route coverage was not claimed.
Mutable/retry integrity is qualified where state exists; pre-solve and stateless failures are explicitly NOT_APPLICABLE.
Provenance and maturity boundaries are recorded for the bounded G11 evidence set.
No executed case silently passed, continued with NaN/Inf, or hid state corruption; aggregation is exhaustive for 20 cases, not every unexecuted public combination.

campaign.state_integrity: PASS for mutable/retry cases; NOT_APPLICABLE for pre-solve/stateless cases

regression_neutrality.fix_behavior: non-finite relative residual is serialized as null with NOT_COMPUTABLE, preserving the failure code
regression_neutrality.global_failures: pre-existing and outside the G11 path; release blockers remain separately tracked

limitations: DIAG-005 remains bounded because all public failure classes and all structured nonlinear reasons were not exhaustively enumerated.
DIAG-008 remains bounded to the 20-case route-native aggregation and makes no universal public-route claim.
No new numerical threshold or solver/formulation change was introduced.
The 18 pre-existing full-regression failures remain release blockers outside G11.
maturity_promotion: No unbounded maturity promotion; G11 is closed only as PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS.
